cases.instance: search typed then fully deleted
cases.title: Clear filters is absent again after the search box is emptied
steps: Mock axios.get with mockResponse().
Render <TicketsPage /> and wait for the rows.
Type "login" into the search input and assert the control appears.
Clear the input with user.clear (or backspaces).
cases.expected: The Clear filters control is not in the document. This is the "" versus undefined asymmetry — visibility computed by truthiness over a "" written by a Clear handler would leave it visible here.

cases.instance: request params after clearing all three filters
cases.title: The post-clear request carries exactly the sort and pagination params
steps: Mock axios.get with mockResponse().
Install the jsdom PointerEvent polyfill.
Render <TicketsPage /> and apply all three filters.
mockedAxios.get.mockClear(); mockedAxios.get.mockResolvedValue(mockResponse()).
Activate Clear filters.
cases.expected: toHaveBeenLastCalledWith("/api/tickets", { params: { sortBy: "createdAt", sortOrder: "desc", page: 1, pageSize: 10 } }) — full-object equality, per Trap 1. An expect.objectContaining assertion here is dilution and must be rejected at review.

cases.instance: unfiltered result set renders after clearing
cases.title: The unfiltered ticket rows are displayed after clearing
steps: Mock axios.get with mockResponse([mockTickets[0]]) for the filtered state.
Render <TicketsPage />, type "login", wait for the single row.
Re-mock with mockResponse() (all three tickets).
Activate Clear filters.
cases.expected: All three subjects render — "Cannot login to my account", "Refund for order #123" and "How do I reset my password?".

cases.instance: cleared search omitted rather than sent as an empty string
cases.title: The post-clear request omits the search param instead of sending an empty one
steps: Mock axios.get with mockResponse().
Render <TicketsPage />, type "login", wait for the filtered request.
mockedAxios.get.mockClear().
Activate Clear filters.
cases.expected: The params object of the last call has no "search" key at all (assert `expect(params).not.toHaveProperty("search")` alongside the full-equality assertion). A handler that writes search: "" spreads it into TicketsTable.tsx:122-128 and puts ?search= on the wire, which AC4 forbids.

cases.instance: post-clear refetch rejects
cases.title: A failed post-clear refetch shows the error alert and leaves the filters cleared
steps: Mock axios.get with mockResponse().
Render <TicketsPage />, type "login", wait for the rows.
Re-mock mockedAxios.get.mockRejectedValue(new Error("Network Error")).
Activate Clear filters. renderWithQuery disables retries, so this settles once.
cases.expected: "Failed to fetch tickets" renders (TicketsTable.tsx:153-155) AND the filter controls remain at their defaults — search input "", both selects at their default labels. Filter state does not roll back to the pre-clear values.

cases.instance: Clear activated while a filtered request is in flight
cases.title: Clearing during an in-flight filtered request settles on the unfiltered result set
steps: Render <TicketsPage /> with axios.get returning a deferred promise for the filtered call.
Type "login" to trigger the filtered request but do not resolve it.
Activate Clear filters and resolve the unfiltered request.
Resolve the stale filtered promise afterwards.
cases.expected: The rendered rows are the unfiltered set and the last request carries no filter params — the stale filtered response does not render last.

cases.instance: subject ascending sort preserved across a clear
cases.title: Clearing filters preserves a Subject ascending sort in the request
steps: Mock axios.get with mockResponse().
Render <TicketsPage /> and wait for the rows.
Click the Subject header once (sortBy subject, sortOrder asc).
Type "login" into the search input, then mockedAxios.get.mockClear().
Activate Clear filters.
cases.expected: toHaveBeenLastCalledWith("/api/tickets", { params: { sortBy: "subject", sortOrder: "asc", page: 1, pageSize: 10 } }) — full equality, so it also proves AC4's omission and AC6's page reset in the same call.

cases.instance: sort indicator still rendered after a clear
cases.title: The Subject header still shows the ascending arrow after clearing filters
steps: Sort Subject ascending, apply a search filter, then activate Clear filters.
Inspect the Subject header button's rendered icon (TicketsTable.tsx:175-181 renders ArrowUp for asc).
cases.expected: The Subject header renders the ascending arrow, not the neutral ArrowUpDown. This is the rendered half of AC5 — the request assertion alone would miss a remount that resets sorting and re-issues the default sort.

cases.instance: clearing from page 3 with a filter active
cases.title: Clearing filters from page 3 settles the query on page 1
steps: Mock axios.get with mockResponse(mockTickets, 50) so total is 50 at pageSize 10.
Render <TicketsPage /> and type "login".
Click "Next page" twice to reach page 3.
mockedAxios.get.mockClear() and re-mock mockResponse(mockTickets, 50).
Activate Clear filters.
cases.expected: toHaveBeenLastCalledWith params page: 1. Assert the LAST call, per Trap 2 — the pageIndex reset happens in the TicketsTable.tsx:107-109 effect, so a page-3 unfiltered request may legitimately fire first. Do NOT assert not.toHaveBeenCalledWith({ page: 3 }).

cases.instance: page indicator after clearing from page 3
cases.title: The page indicator reads Page 1 after clearing filters from page 3
steps: Reach page 3 with a filter active against a 50-ticket total.
Activate Clear filters and wait for state to settle.
cases.expected: The indicator span (TicketsTable.tsx:252-254) reads "Page 1 of 5" and the range text reads "Showing 1–10 of 50 tickets".
